_doc: Industrial Corridor page type sources (docs/corridors/sriperumbudur/DECISIONS.md). CADENCE + TIER ARE DOCUMENTATION ONLY - decided 2026-07-26: neither gates polling; cadence is a CLAIM and claims are wrong.

sources.publisher: CGWB / TN SG&SWRDC via IN-GRES (IIT Hyderabad)
sources.refreshMethod: python3 scripts/build_corridor_sriperumbudur.py, then python3 scripts/verify_corridor_assessment.py (cross-check gate, must exit 0 before publish; D12d)
sources.notes: Assessment API + GeoServer firka geometry (gec:indgec_vers_tamilnadu). JOIN RULE (D2): the API's reportSummary firka uuids match the year=2022 polygon vintage, asserted by the build script. When a new assessment year appears in the portal year list, add it to TALUK_EDITIONS and re-run both scripts. CAVEAT (shared with ingres-gw-assessment-tn): http-meta watches the SPA build, not the data; a redeploy false-positives and a data-only update could be missed.

sources.publisher: SIPCOT GIS, Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.license: no stated open license ('All Rights Reserved' footer); reuse confirmation requested 2026-07-27, boundaries shipped with attribution pending reply (D4)
sources.refreshMethod: python3 scripts/build_corridor_sriperumbudur.py (WFS pull of cite:industrial_complex_boundary-<ParkKey>, outer boundaries only; the plot-level allottee layer is deliberately NOT fetched per D4/D8)
sources.notes: GeoServer WFS on port 8086, no auth. Park keys are exact database names (e.g. Oragadam_DTA, not Oragadam). Polygon extent exceeds the notified-saleable-area attribute; the attribute must never be presented as the polygon's area.
